item.title: DietPi 10.2 Released with Immich Support and New Software Options
item.description: DietPi 10.2 adds Immich, Immich Machine Learning, uv, and RustDesk Client, alongside tool improvements, configuration updates, and multiple bug fixes.

item.title: Krita 5.3 and Krita 6.0 Released With New Text Engine and Wayland HDR Support
item.description: Krita 5.3 delivers a new text engine and updated tools, alongside Krita 6.0, the Qt 6-based release with early Wayland support.

item.title: NVIDIA 595.58 Linux Driver Released With Multiple Kernel Crash Fixes
item.description: NVIDIA 595.58 is now available for download, resolving kernel crashes, X11 compositor flicker, and Wayland display wake issues on Linux systems.

item.title: GNOME 48.10 Released as Final Bugfix Update for GNOME 48
item.description: GNOME 48.10 is out as the last maintenance update in the GNOME 48 lifecycle, focusing on fixes across core components like Shell, GTK, and Mutter.

item.title: Mozilla Thunderbird 149 Brings Address Book Export and Multiple Bug Fixes
item.description: Mozilla Thunderbird 149 introduces address book export, improves EWS message sync, and resolves multiple bugs across email, calendar, and encryption features.

item.title: KaOS 2026.03 Released With Major Move Away From systemd Components
item.description: KaOS 2026.03 removes systemd-boot and mkinitcpio, adopts Limine and Dracut, and introduces a new Niri-based desktop environment.

item.title: MX Linux Takes Clear Stance Against Age Verification Requirements
item.description: MX Linux opposes age verification rules, citing concerns about privacy and the impact on open source development.

item.title: Celluloid 0.30 Video Player Improves Playback UI
item.description: Celluloid 0.30 video player fixes Blu-ray detection, improves file chooser behavior, and updates UI elements, including the shortcuts dialog.

item.title: Incus 6.23 Container & Virtual Machine Manager Released
item.description: Incus 6.23 arrives as the final 6.x release before 7.0 LTS, bringing security fixes, new features, and improved VM and storage capabilities.

item.title: Linuxiac Weekly Wrap-Up: Week 13, 2026 (Mar 23 – 29)
item.description: Catch up on the latest Linux news: Kali 2026.1, GIMP 3.2.2, Firefox 149, NVIDIA 595.58, Fish Shell 4.6, Krita 6.0, Canonical plans controversial GRUB changes, and more.

item.title: Ubuntu MATE Founder Martin Wimpress Steps Back After 12 Years
item.description: After 12 years, Ubuntu MATE founder Martin Wimpress is stepping back, and the project is now seeking new maintainers to assume key responsibilities.

item.title: Rspamd 4.0 Spam Filtering System Released With checkv3 Protocol
item.description: Rspamd 4.0 open-source spam filtering system introduces the new checkv3 protocol, built-in Fasttext, major backend changes, and more.

item.title: Archinstall 4.0 Introduces New Textual TUI for Arch Linux Installer
item.description: Archinstall 4.0 introduces a modern textual UI, replacing the curses interface to enhance usability and accessibility in the Arch Linux installer.

item.title: Fastfetch 2.61 System Information Tool Drops Windows 7 and 8 Support
item.description: Fastfetch 2.61 drops Windows 7 and 8 support, introduces faster GPU detection, and transitions to a pure C build on Linux.

item.title: GNOME 49.5 Improves Stability With Fixes in Shell, Nautilus, and Mutter
item.description: The GNOME 49.5 update delivers fixes across the desktop stack, including Shell, Nautilus, and Web, along with important GLib security patches.
